gəmganganno has the first-person speaker as sole moving participant, hedi hedi as manner and bi ǧaʕda as route. The thirst and water request explain the slow, exhausted movement already covered by the inherited gloss.
The -nn- sequence is compatible with assimilation of stem-final l before first-person n; it does not establish a separate gngn root or another paradigm.

The assigned occurrence provides no evidence for inherited sense 2, small particles being picked out of a heap. Retain that inherited sense and its numbering without inventing an example or removing it for lack of evidence in this one-token sample.
